idea-plugin.name: Spring Config Guard
idea-plugin.description:
Detect risky Spring Boot production configuration before it is committed or deployed.

Spring Config Guard performs deterministic, local analysis of Spring Boot application.yml, application.yaml, and application.properties files.

  • Highlights risky production settings with value-free findings.
  • Analyzes profile drift and inherited local endpoints.
  • Maps configuration keys to Java @Value and @ConfigurationProperties references.
  • Reviews changed configuration and warns before a local commit without blocking it.

Project source and configuration are not uploaded.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.1.0

  • Initial deterministic production-risk inspections for five Spring Boot settings.
  • Local profile-drift, config-to-Java mapping, and changed-configuration reports.
  • Optional per-project, value-free commit warnings that never block the commit.
